01-flow:
flowchart TB
  start(["Order received"])
  validate["Validate order"]
  valid{"Order valid?"}
  reject["Notify customer of rejection"]
  stock{"Items in stock?"}
  backorder["Create backorder"]
  wait["Wait for restock"]
  reserve["Reserve inventory"]
  pay["Charge payment"]
  paid{"Payment approved?"}
  retry{"Retries left?"}
  cancel["Cancel and release stock"]
  ship["Pick, pack and ship"]
  notify["Send tracking e-mail"]
  done(["Order complete"])
  failed(["Order closed"])
  start --> validate
  validate --> valid
  valid -->|"yes"| stock
  valid -->|"no"| reject
  reject --> failed
  stock -->|"yes"| reserve
  stock -->|"no"| backorder
  backorder --> wait
  wait -->|"restocked"| stock
  reserve --> pay
  pay --> paid
  paid -->|"yes"| ship
  paid -->|"no"| retry
  retry -->|"yes"| pay
  retry -->|"no"| cancel
  cancel --> failed
  ship --> notify
  notify --> done
